title: Choose the visual world for KKN Travels
question: Four more luxury-minimal directions, plus the previous three for comparison. Pick one, or type a steer.

options.label: Desert Light
options.thesis: Warm, open and unmistakably Gulf: golden dunes under a huge calm sky, with a centred headline and one floating enquiry bar.
options.viewport: Dunes at golden hour fill the screen; the headline sits centred in the sky, and a white enquiry bar floats over the sand at the bottom.
options.risk: Reads more holiday than paperwork; the copy has to keep visas in front.

options.label: Atelier Monochrome
options.thesis: Black, white and nothing else: an oversized serif headline across the full width and black-and-white photography.
options.viewport: The headline runs edge to edge at the top; beneath it a tall black-and-white aircraft photograph, a text column, and a quiet list of services.
options.risk: Severe and fashion-led; some visitors may find it cold for a service desk.

options.label: Emerald Lounge
options.lineage: members' club and first-class lounge sites
options.thesis: A solid deep-emerald panel beside a full-height photograph, cream serif type, and an enquiry card that bridges the two.
options.viewport: Left half is solid emerald with the headline in cream; right half is a full-height photograph of a quiet airport lounge; a cream enquiry card straddles the seam.
options.risk: Green and brass is rich and distinctive, but leans club-like rather than corporate.

options.label: Burgundy Cabin
options.thesis: Airline-grade corporate: a wide cinematic cabin photograph on top, then headline and service index on oyster grey with burgundy accents.
options.viewport: A wide strip of aircraft windows at sunrise spans the top; below, the headline at left and a two-column list of services at right, with a burgundy button.
options.risk: Burgundy and grey will remind people of a well-known Gulf airline.

options.label: Private Terminal
options.thesis: Dark, quiet and cinematic: one full-screen photograph, a fine serif headline and almost nothing else.
options.viewport: A business-jet wing at dawn fills the screen; a light serif headline sits in the dark space at left, with a slim glass enquiry bar along the bottom.
options.risk: Dark with a brass accent sits close to the navy-and-gold habit of Dubai agencies; it has to win on restraint.

options.label: Concierge Desk
options.thesis: Light, spacious and editorial: stone-white space, a refined serif, and two carefully framed photographs.
options.viewport: A calm serif headline on stone white at left; at right a tall photograph of a passport handed across a marble desk, a smaller cloudscape overlapping it; services listed on a hairline row beneath.
options.risk: Soft and understated; needs strong photography or it reads as a hotel template.

options.label: Morning Skyline
options.thesis: Bright, corporate and confident: a pale morning skyline, deep sapphire type and a frosted-glass enquiry card.
options.viewport: Dubai's skyline in soft morning haze fills the screen; a sapphire headline at left, a frosted-glass enquiry card at right, and a white service bar along the bottom.
options.risk: The most familiar of the set: a skyline hero is what the category already ships, just cooler and cleaner.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What agencies like Musafir, Akbar Travels and Regal Tours ship: skyline photo, navy and gold, icon service cards, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed Dubai skyline photo with a headline, two buttons and a row of service cards beneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
